audience: People discovering experimental live music; phone use while travelling to the venue.
request: Build a distinctive, expressive festival programme website with a strong graphic identity. The central task is to explore the lineup and save a personal programme. Use bold composition and original graphic artwork where it helps; keep the schedule readable.

facts.name: Signal
facts.tagline: A day of sound, a little out of place.
facts.intro: Live electronics, close listening and the spaces in between. Three rooms, one day.

required_behavior: Filter by room, including an All reset.
Save and unsave any event. The saved count and a My programme view must reflect the actual saved selection, including a useful empty state.
The day pass control must reveal the known price/date/location and clearly explain that checkout is unavailable in this local demo. Do not invent a payment flow.
constraints: Fictional local demo. No sponsors, testimonials, social counts or other invented proof.
No fixed palette or typeface; use available system font stacks.
No external images/fonts/network dependencies. Create original CSS or SVG artwork if useful.
